author: Adam Rosen
title: Arrest made after chase of reportedly stolen vehicle leads to crash in Arapahoe County - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Rosen ,
4 hours ago
DENVER (KDVR) - Officials announced an arrest stemming from a pursuit that led to a multi-vehicle crash on East Iliff Avenue on Tuesday.
The Arapahoe County Sheriff's Office said in an update that deputies are continuing to investigate an incident that began when officials were near the Storelocal Storage in the 1900 block of South Valencia Street.
While at the scene, deputies reportedly noticed a vehicle with a license plate that had been reported as stolen, later deeming the vehicle was also reported as stolen.
Pursuit leads to multi-vehicle crash with injuries in Arapahoe County The driver allegedly fled upon an attempted contact by deputies, speeding up towards another deputy before reportedly striking a closed security gate, causing heavy damage to the gate and the vehicle.
The driver's view was obstructed due to the damage; however, the suspect allegedly continued to flee onto East Iliff Avenue at nearly 70 miles per hour before hitting another vehicle, sending debris into a third.
Denver nightclub’s licenses suspended over security guard allegations The driver, now identified as 26-year-old Leinaala La Shomb, was arrested and formal charges will be determined by the 18th Judicial District Attorney's Office.
The driver of the vehicle that was directly struck was hospitalized with serious injuries. The Denver Police Department is handling the crash investigation.
